description: Horizontal scrolling strip with proximity snap points, an optional scrollbar and edge hints. Attribute form: data-layout="reel". When the items hold no focusable content, add role="region", aria-label and tabindex="0" so keyboard users can scroll it.

attributes.name: data-layout-scrollbar
attributes.description: Show a thin scrollbar. Hidden by default, except under forced colours and on touch-only (hover: none) devices, where it always shows.

attributes.name: data-layout-gap
attributes.description: Gap between items, on the shared size scale.

attributes.name: data-layout-padding
attributes.description: Padding on all sides (block padding leaves room for focus rings and shadows); the same value is the inline scroll padding.

attributes.name: data-layout-item-width
attributes.description: Item width: auto (content), s / m / l / xl tokens, or full (100%).

attributes.name: data-scroll-hint
attributes.description: Fade the edges to hint at overflow, logically (mirrored in RTL). Where scroll-driven animations are supported each edge fades only while there is more content that way; elsewhere both edges fade. start: only the end edge ever fades.

childAttributes.name: data-container
childAttributes.description: Opt a semantic child back into container queries (the reel removes container-type from such children so they size to content).
